policy.p0: Every P0 KPI must be referenced by at least one control-bus scenario.
policy.p1: P1 KPIs may warn before live scenario promotion only when each gap has an owner, reason, promotion trigger, and closure condition.
policy.p2: P2 KPIs may remain tracked-only only when each gap is intentional and visible to the public contract.

explicitGaps.reason: Dropdown surfaces need one reusable control-bus action for menu opening before per-dropdown scenarios are useful.
explicitGaps.promotionTrigger: Any dropdown performance bug, visual regression, or new dropdown-heavy workflow.
explicitGaps.closureCondition: Add a live P1 scenario that opens a representative dropdown and waits for geometry-stable dropdown visibility.

explicitGaps.reason: Right-sidebar routes are lower frequency than chat/sidebar P0 and need stable representative fixture content before gating.
explicitGaps.promotionTrigger: Right sidebar becomes part of a core agent-monitoring workflow or regresses perceptibly.
explicitGaps.closureCondition: Add a live P1 scenario that opens the right sidebar under medium fixture load and records geometry samples.

explicitGaps.reason: Switching right-sidebar items needs stable target ids before the runner can measure a representative item switch.
explicitGaps.promotionTrigger: Multiple right-sidebar items become regularly used during agent monitoring.
explicitGaps.closureCondition: Add a live P1 scenario that switches between two right-sidebar items and waits for the target item frame to stabilize.

explicitGaps.reason: Browser panel opening is not on the P0 agent-conversation path but must remain visible as a warning KPI.
explicitGaps.promotionTrigger: Browser panel becomes part of a frequent agent inspection workflow.
explicitGaps.closureCondition: Add a live P1 scenario that opens the browser panel with a public-safe fixture and waits for panel visibility.

explicitGaps.reason: Browser panel switching needs stable panel route targets before live coverage is meaningful.
explicitGaps.promotionTrigger: Browser panel switching becomes common in multi-agent workflows.
explicitGaps.closureCondition: Add a live P1 scenario that switches browser-panel content and records frame-stable completion.

explicitGaps.reason: Work-summary expansion requires fixture rows with work summaries and stable expansion control ids.
explicitGaps.promotionTrigger: Work summaries are edited, virtualized, or reported as slow in dense transcripts.
explicitGaps.closureCondition: Add a dense-chat or streaming-heavy P1 scenario that expands and collapses a work summary row.

explicitGaps.reason: Tool/action detail expansion requires fixture rows with tool detail controls and stable row anchors.
explicitGaps.promotionTrigger: Tool/action detail UI changes or dense transcript tool rows become a target workflow.
explicitGaps.closureCondition: Add a dense-chat or streaming-heavy P1 scenario that expands and collapses tool/action detail.

explicitGaps.reason: Attachment preview needs a public-safe fixture attachment and a no-service staging path before live measurement.
explicitGaps.promotionTrigger: Attachment preview is touched, reported slow, or added to normal agent workflows.
explicitGaps.closureCondition: Add a medium-fixture P1 scenario that stages a public-safe attachment and waits for preview visibility.

explicitGaps.reason: Search opening is lower priority than P0 chat/sidebar but must be promoted before search optimization work.
explicitGaps.promotionTrigger: Search UI changes, search is optimized, or search becomes a frequent agent navigation path.
explicitGaps.closureCondition: Add a medium or dense-sidebar P1 scenario that opens search and waits for input visibility.

explicitGaps.reason: Search result paint requires deterministic public-safe searchable fixture content.
explicitGaps.promotionTrigger: Search indexing, result rendering, or sidebar filtering changes.
explicitGaps.closureCondition: Add a medium or dense-sidebar P1 scenario that opens search, types a deterministic query, and waits for first result paint.

explicitGaps.reason: Project switching needs deterministic project fixture data in the macOS fixture pack.
explicitGaps.promotionTrigger: Project navigation changes or project-heavy workflows become central to agent monitoring.
explicitGaps.closureCondition: Add a dense-sidebar P1 scenario that switches to a fixture project and waits for project conversation list stability.

explicitGaps.reason: Pinned view has fixture data but still needs a dedicated control-bus route action before scenario coverage.
explicitGaps.promotionTrigger: Pinned view changes, pinning performance work, or frequent pinned workflow usage.
explicitGaps.closureCondition: Add a dense-sidebar P1 scenario that switches to pinned view and waits for pinned list stability.

explicitGaps.reason: Archived/all filter switching needs stable filter controls and deterministic archived fixture rows.
explicitGaps.promotionTrigger: Chat filter UI changes or filtering becomes part of core monitoring workflows.
explicitGaps.closureCondition: Add a dense-sidebar P1 scenario that switches filters and waits for filtered list stability.

explicitGaps.reason: Empty, loading, and error states need explicit fixture toggles so scenarios do not depend on real failures.
explicitGaps.promotionTrigger: State surfaces are redesigned or a bug involves loading, empty, or error transitions.
explicitGaps.closureCondition: Add a smoke P1 scenario that triggers a synthetic state transition and waits for target state visibility.

explicitGaps.reason: Resize measurement needs a control-bus resize primitive that does not use the shared cursor.
explicitGaps.promotionTrigger: Window layout work, resize regressions, or multi-window performance work.
explicitGaps.closureCondition: Add a medium P1 scenario that resizes the agent window and records primary-frame stability.

explicitGaps.reason: Multi-window switching requires a runner-level two-instance orchestration path.
explicitGaps.promotionTrigger: Multi-window agent workflows are optimized or reported slow.
explicitGaps.closureCondition: Add a P1 suite scenario that provisions two agent instances and measures target-window readiness.

explicitGaps.reason: Rare settings panes are intentionally tracked but not part of normal agent-monitoring performance gates.
explicitGaps.promotionTrigger: A rare settings pane becomes high-traffic or is directly edited.
explicitGaps.closureCondition: Add a tracked or warning scenario for the specific pane being changed.

explicitGaps.reason: Deep integration panels are intentionally tracked without live coverage until an integration panel is changed.
explicitGaps.promotionTrigger: A deep integration panel becomes part of a frequent workflow or receives performance work.
explicitGaps.closureCondition: Add a tracked scenario for the integration panel being changed.

explicitGaps.reason: Secondary provider surfaces are low-frequency and may involve provider-specific setup that must stay out of public fixtures.
explicitGaps.promotionTrigger: A secondary provider surface is changed or becomes user-visible in common flows.
explicitGaps.closureCondition: Add a public-safe tracked scenario or mark provider prerequisites as external pending.

explicitGaps.reason: Diagnostics panels are explicit support surfaces and must not block P0 monitoring work.
explicitGaps.promotionTrigger: Diagnostics UI receives performance work or becomes a common debugging workflow.
explicitGaps.closureCondition: Add a tracked scenario that opens diagnostics from a public-safe fixture state.

explicitGaps.reason: Maintenance flows are rare, support-like paths and should remain tracked unless directly changed.
explicitGaps.promotionTrigger: A maintenance flow becomes frequent or receives UI/runtime changes.
explicitGaps.closureCondition: Add a tracked scenario for the specific maintenance flow being changed.

explicitGaps.reason: Visual information panels are low-frequency explanatory surfaces.
explicitGaps.promotionTrigger: An information panel is redesigned, reported slow, or becomes part of a frequent workflow.
explicitGaps.closureCondition: Add a tracked scenario that opens the relevant panel and waits for stable visibility.
